questions.question: What did Jonah do from inside the fish?
options: Cursed the day he was born
Prayed to the LORD his God
questions.answer: Prayed to the LORD his God

questions.question: What did Jonah declare in his prayer?
options: He deserved to die in the sea
He was lost beyond all hope
He had turned away from God

questions.question: After Jonah prayed, the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah out onto dry land.
I called out to the LORD, out of my distress, and he _____ me.
